python3 -c "
import zipfile, re
z = zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx')
xml = z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml').decode('utf-8')
exp = [(int(r.group(1)), r.group(2), int(r.group(3)))
       for r in re.finditer(r'<row r=\"(\d+)\">.*?<c r=\"C(\d+)\" t=\"n\"><v>(\d+)</v>', xml)]
cat = {}
for row, c, v in exp:
    m = re.search(r'<c r=\"A%d\"[^>]*><is><t>([^<]+)</t>' % row, xml)
    cat.setdefault(m.group(1), 0)
    cat[m.group(1)] += v
total = sum(cat.values())
for k, v in cat.items():
    print(f'{k}: {v}')
print(f'TOTAL EXPENSES: {total}')
print(f'Formula SUM(C11:C22) would equal: {sum(v for _,_,v in exp)}')
"

python3 -c "
import zipfile, re
from collections import OrderedDict
z = zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx')
xml = z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml').decode('utf-8')
rows = re.findall(r'<row r=\"(\d+)\">(.*?)</row>', xml)
cats = OrderedDict()
for rn, body in rows:
    rn = int(rn)
    if not (11 <= rn <= 22):
        continue
    a = re.search(r'<c r=\"A%d\"[^>]*><is><t>([^<]+)</t>' % rn, body)
    c = re.search(r'<c r=\"C%d\" t=\"n\"><v>(\d+)</v>' % rn, body)
    if a and c:
        cats.setdefault(a.group(1), 0)
        cats[a.group(1)] += int(c.group(1))
for k, v in cats.items():
    print(f'{k}: {v}')
print('TOTAL EXPENSES:', sum(cats.values()))
"
